name: Eastron SDM120 (SDM120-Modbus)
doc_revision: SDM120-Modbus RTU Protocol - 'Eastron SDM120Modbus Smart Meter Modbus Protocol Implementation V2.4' (Zhejiang Eastron, 8 pages, PDF created 2019-08)
notes: Built only from the Eastron protocol PDF listed in 'source'. Addressing: the document lists register numbers (30001 = input register, 40001 = holding register) plus the 'Modbus Protocol Start Address Hex'. This preset uses address_base 0 and the PROTOCOL address: input register number minus 30001 (e.g. 30073 -> 72 = 0x0048), holding register number minus 40001 (e.g. 40021 -> 20 = 0x0014); all addresses were cross-checked against the doc's hex column. The F9xx / FCxx registers are taken from the hex column (463745 -> 0xF900, 463761 -> 0xF910, 463777 -> 0xF920, 464513 -> 0xFC00, 464515 -> 0xFC02, 464516 -> 0xFC03). All measurements are 32-bit IEEE754 floats, high register first (doc example: 43 66 33 34 = 230.2 V). Reads must start on an even address and use an even register count. Config values such as baud/parity/ID are also stored as 4-byte floats (FC03 read, FC16 write), per the document. Defaults stated by the doc: ID 1, parity/stop code 0 (1 stop, no parity), baud code 0 = 2400 baud (doc marks 2400 as default); parity/baud/ID changes need a restart. NOT included: no 'reset' registers are documented in this PDF; the demand block is included read-only. The document gives no register for 'Demand time' even though its example mentions it, so it is omitted. Word order of the unsigned-int32 serial number is not stated (big assumed by the tool default, see point note). Not verified against a physical device. Document version V2.4 may differ from other SDM120 hardware revisions. max_block=40: the protocol document limits one request to 40 values (80 registers).

points.name: Relay pulse width
points.note: Doc: relay on period in ms, 60, 100 or 200, default 100. min/max are the extremes of the three allowed values; only 60/100/200 are valid. Holding register that stores the value as a 32-bit IEEE754 float (2 registers, 4 bytes); doc: write only one parameter per message, FC16.

points.name: Network parity/stop
points.note: Requires a restart to become effective. Holding register that stores the value as a 32-bit IEEE754 float (2 registers, 4 bytes); doc: write only one parameter per message, FC16.

points.name: Meter ID (Modbus address)
points.note: Doc: ranges from 1 to 247, default 1. Holding register that stores the value as a 32-bit IEEE754 float (2 registers, 4 bytes); doc: write only one parameter per message, FC16.

points.name: Baud rate
points.note: Doc lists only codes 0, 1, 2 and 5. Holding register that stores the value as a 32-bit IEEE754 float (2 registers, 4 bytes); doc: write only one parameter per message, FC16.

points.name: Pulse 1 output mode
points.note: Doc writes these as 0001, 0002, 0004, 0005, 0006, 0008 in a float. Holding register that stores the value as a 32-bit IEEE754 float (2 registers, 4 bytes); doc: write only one parameter per message, FC16.

points.name: Time of scroll display
points.note: Doc: range 0-30 s, default 0 = does not display in turns. 2-byte HEX. Register number 463745.

points.name: Serial number
points.note: Doc: unsigned int32, read only (register number 464513). Word order is not stated in the doc; big (tool default) is an assumption.

points.name: Meter code
points.note: Doc: 'Meter code = 00 20', 2-byte HEX, read only (register number 464515).
